title: Chunk overlap silently dropped
story: A RAG pipeline asks for chunks that overlap by 20 characters, so no sentence is cut in half at a chunk boundary. When the text has no blank line in it, the splitter quietly returned chunks with no overlap at all.
shipped: In every release from 2.12.0 (April 2025) to 2.30.2: 37 releases over 15 months. We checked 6 of them, both ends and four between.

title: Answer metadata silently dropped
story: A RAG pipeline attaches where each answer came from, a source URL and a policy version, for citations and audit. When the reply came from a chat model, AnswerBuilder kept the model's metadata and threw the caller's away.

title: The model was told the wrong thing
story: An agent describes the structured output it wants: a fruit or a vehicle, and what each should hold. For a union of output types, the model was told "A vehicle", the docstring of the last type, whatever description the caller gave.
